title: Market-Derived Features + CalibratedClassifierCV for Brier ≤ 0.202
hypothesis: Adding bookmaker-derived features (implied probability, spread, total, overround) as inputs to our GA feature engine will close the gap from 0.22169 to ≤0.202. Literature shows XGBoost + market features achieves Brier 0.202 with ROI +43.8%, vs our 0.22169 without market features.

evidence.source: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets (MDPI Information, 2026-01-08)
evidence.key_finding: XGBoost with market-derived features (moneyline, spread, total, overround + 5-game rolling win rate) achieved Brier 0.202, log-loss 0.589, ROI +43.8%. Logistic regression achieved Brier 0.199 but negative ROI. Market features dominate non-market features in ablation.
evidence.calibration_finding: CalibratedClassifierCV with auto-selection (sigmoid vs isotonic vs none) improved Brier by ~0.003 in cross-validation vs uncalibrated XGBoost.

proposed_features.name: market_overround
proposed_features.interpretation: Bookmaker confidence proxy — higher overround = tighter game

proposed_features.name: implied_prob_vs_model_delta
proposed_features.interpretation: EV signal: positive delta = model disagrees with market

proposed_features.name: rolling_5g_win_rate_home
proposed_features.note: Already exists in engine — verify inclusion

calibration_upgrade.method_selection: auto (sigmoid, isotonic, none — pick by val Brier)
calibration_upgrade.implementation: Wrap best model from GA in CalibratedClassifierCV before final evaluation. Add calibrated_brier to fitness tuple.

implementation_plan.action: Add odds data fetch to ops/fetch_nba_data.py
implementation_plan.source: odds-api.com (free tier: 500 req/mo) or scraped from basketball-reference

implementation_plan.note: Strictly lagged — only pre-game odds, no live data

implementation_plan.action: Add CalibratedClassifierCV wrapper in HF space app.py evaluate_individual()
implementation_plan.change: calibrated = CalibratedClassifierCV(model, cv=3, method='isotonic'); calibrated.fit(X_val, y_val); brier = brier_score_loss(y_test, calibrated.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1])

implementation_plan.action: Deploy updated engine to S14 (active best) first, A/B test
implementation_plan.success_criterion: S14 brier improves by ≥0.002 within 50 gens

risk: Market features could cause overfitting if odds are directly correlated with outcomes (circular). Mitigation: strict lag (closing odds from day before game), cross-season robustness check.
expected_outcome: Brier improvement from 0.22169 → 0.215 range. Closes gap to Colab TabICL best (0.21514). Potential to hit checkpoint threshold 0.21837.

cross_project_applicability.political_alpha: Kalshi/Polymarket implied probabilities for political events = equivalent market features. Apply same pattern: implied_prob + overround + delta_from_model.
cross_project_applicability.note: Political prediction markets are even more informative than sports books
